feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: White House launches 'Trump TV' after ban on major news outlets
entry.summary: Days after President Trump barred reporters from three major news outlets from the White House, the administration has launched a 24/7 YouTube channel promising to put its "biggest moments all in one place."

entry.title: RFK Jr.'s ethics disclosure reveals free travel and hefty book advances
entry.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s latest financial disclosure reveals he accepted free flights to Fiji and Greece and lucrative book advances.

entry.title: Is President Trump the world's peacekeeper?
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott about President Trump's speech to the United Nations and America's place in the world.

entry.title: Trump's D.C. arch is now a military complex. Here's how that complicates things
entry.summary: The future of Trump's D.C. arch was already fraught. Then he rebranded it as a military complex. Experts say that only raises more legal and logistical questions.

entry.title: The House Freedom Caucus has to transform — it could preview the GOP's post-Trump era
entry.summary: The conservative House Freedom Caucus grew in prominence alongside President Trump. Now they are considering what the future of their movement looks like.

entry.title: Trump heads to the U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
entry.summary: The past couple of weeks have been particularly challenging for Trump with a series of legal and political setbacks.

entry.title: A U.S. House race in Arizona could hinge on voters' opinion of the Big Beautiful Bill
entry.summary: The reelection campaign by a Republican congressman in Arizona could hinge on voter perceptions of last year's massive GOP-backed spending bill.

entry.title: Trump's big weekend: The arch, Greenland, and media outlets banned from White House
entry.summary: President Trump's exertion of power over the press, Greenland and even the D.C. landscape are teeing up questions over the president's limits.

entry.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
entry.summary: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
entry.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.
